notes.title: Patch 1.1 – new features, fixes and optimization improvements
notes.notes:
Thanks for all the messages, I'm still working on the fixes.

But here is the list of this patch:

1 - flashing light problems on skeletal mesh of the Cyborg fixed
2 - double jump time adjusted
3 - weapons recoil improved
4 - some enemy sounds improved
5 - nav area of the enemies (where they can go) improved
6 - taking damage visual and sound improved
7 - glow overall adjusted to let less light and improve performance

[b]8 - Now you can change your weapons on the blue tube in the time between the waves[/b]

9 - Performance improved by other visual adjustments
10 - Fixed the fog inside watter
11 - Fixed some flying grenades that was happening on the server by clients
12 - There is more ammo on the map now
13 - Now you have the maximum FPS to 300, don't need to change in the settings on menu

This is a short list and like I said I'm still working on the improvements and fixes you are asking for.

And I'm also developing a new map called Iceplanet (coming next)
